comment: Synthetic dictionary used by the automated tests.
Every definition here was written for this project. Nothing is copied from
WordNet or from any other dictionary: the tests need a dictionary whose
every state is known, not a sample of real data, and the real 29 MB
dataset must never be downloaded by a test.
The entries are chosen to exercise each state of the lookup pipeline:
exact hits, case suppression, inflection shadowing, hyphen and dotted
forms, contraction hosts, morphology, a malformed record and a miss.
Build it with: npm run dictionary:fixture
